headline: Anthropic Maps the Claude Plugin Frontier
lede: Anthropic’s official marketplace turns Claude Code extensions into a governed, modular system. Standard manifests, MCP configuration, stable naming, and curated submissions give agents an ecosystem they can reliably grow into.

headline: A Local Agent Runs the Job Hunt
lede: AI Job Search keeps the application pipeline on the candidate’s machine, from listing discovery to tailored LaTeX documents and interview preparation. Profile data, review steps, and outcome tracking form a private workflow rather than another hosted dashboard.

headline: ECC Turns Coding Agents Into Engineering Teams
lede: ECC lays out a repeatable plan–test–review–verify cycle for coding assistants, then supplies the machinery to run it. Sixty-eight agents, 293 skills, persistent memory, and AgentShield make the harness feel less like a prompt and more like an operating plan.

headline: CLI-Anything Gives Agents a Command Surface
lede: CLI-Anything converts complex desktop applications into predictable command-line harnesses that agents can inspect and operate. A shared hub, hardened tokens, input sanitization, and automated tests target the fragile last mile between model intent and real software.

headline: A Field Guide for Scientific Agents
lede: Scientific Agent Skills catalogs 163 validated workflows across more than 100 scientific databases and disciplines. Its portable skill format gives researchers a documented bridge from language-model reasoning to bioinformatics, drug discovery, physics, and geospatial tools.

headline: AI Memory Carries Context Across Sessions
lede: ai-memory captures agent activity, distills it into a git-backed Markdown knowledge base, and exposes it through search and optional vector retrieval. Startup briefs and explicit handoffs keep project context moving across tools, machines, and collaborators without requiring an always-on AI service.

headline: Android Publishes Skills for Better Agent Work
lede: Android/skills packages specialized guidance for the places coding agents routinely stumble, from tooling to performance and interface work. Install one skill or the full collection, and agents can draw from official Android practices without repeating the same instructions in every session.

headline: Orca Coordinates Coding Agents at Scale
lede: Orca gives multiple coding agents isolated Git worktrees, persistent terminals, remote workspaces, and a controlled path for comparing and merging results. Its desktop, mobile, SSH, GitHub, and Linear integrations turn parallel experimentation into an operational workspace.

headline: Claude Code Brings the Agent Into Shell
lede: Claude Code works directly against a local repository, translating natural-language requests into file edits, commands, and Git workflows. Its terminal-first design keeps context near the code while plugins extend the tool for specialized jobs across macOS, Linux, and Windows.

headline: VoiceStudio Puts 646 Languages on Device
lede: VoiceStudio brings voice cloning, design, dubbing, and audiobook production into a local desktop workspace. With 646 languages, multiple speech engines, and hardware acceleration for CUDA, Apple Silicon, and ROCm, it makes the case for owning the entire audio pipeline.
